title: What Is SQL Injection? How a Login Box Gets Hacked
description:
SQL injection happens when typed input is run as database code, and parameterized queries stop it by keeping input as data.
The table rows and the example input shown are illustrative; real apps vary.
No repo author to credit.
Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
